1-3.summary: Exploring synergies and risks where AI and blockchain intersect — data, governance, and real-world use cases.
agenda: Where AI and blockchain meet in practice: data provenance, AI agents that hold assets and transact, and on-chain records of automated decisions

What feeds forward: use-case framing and governance risk notes for the FASE track, and handoffs to the Agentic AI and Security AI Agent work
Next steps and owners for the meeting report

Guidance for applying the metrics consistently, and next steps for the report

Implementation realities from issuers and intermediaries
Roadmap update for the Practical Stablecoin Implementation Guide
